type_notation: string | bool | int | null | object | array; {enum}; {nullable: T}; {object: {required, optional}}; {array: T}; forbidden: keys that must be absent; relations: checks between the answer and the request or between fields; controls: failing cases each check must be shown to catch

version_probe.acceptance: exact; checked at start on the exact aw executable before any effect; refuse when missing, malformed or not the accepted number

rules.invocation: argument array, never a shell; --json on every listed command except output exit-only; secrets on stdin; --flag value and --flag=value are the same
rules.selector: --identity-home ABSOLUTE_PATH before the subcommand; then AWEB_IDENTITY_HOME; then ./.aw; an unloadable selection fails without fallback
rules.stdout: json commands: exactly one JSON document on success; key order, whitespace and the name key are not promised; unlisted keys are ignored
rules.exit_and_effect: an exit status alone never says whether something changed; commands that write state the recorded facts to read after a nonzero exit
rules.retry: next_step and commands in messages are operator text; the framework retries only by a command's recovery rule: same argv, executable, --identity-home and routing inputs (AWEB_URL, AWID_REGISTRY_URL, --server-name)
